messages:
support_jen: Heads-up — we have a deploy scheduled for tonight 03:00 UTC to prod-eu. Want to lock down the statuspage blurb and rollback thresholds now so support can send customer notices.

mike_eng: thanks. what's the release tag? any risky changes?

support_jen: release tag is release/2.14.0. Main changes: model runtime kernel upgrade (fallbacks), improved batching, and a tweak to KV cache eviction. No schema changes.

lena_ops: deploy-bot scheduled it as:
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: release/2.14.0 -> prod-eu (window: 2026-03-21 03:00-04:00 UTC). Canary: 5% for 15m, then progressive.

product_jess: KV eviction touches could cause transient token-level latency spikes for some long-chat workloads — suggest a canary watch of 5-10 pinned customers and an immediate rollback threshold at >2s p50 regression vs baseline for >10m.

mike_eng: agree. propose rollback triggers:
- error rate (5xx) > 0.5% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 40% vs pre-deploy for 10m
- p50 latency increase > 1s sustained for 15m for any pinned customer
- obvious model quality regressions reported via evals or support tickets

support_jen: good, add a comms flow too. If canary fails we'll:
1) push statuspage: partial outage for "Inference: EU" with note "investigating increased latency"
2) notify pinned customers via email template below
3) rollback to release/2.13.8 and follow postmortem checklist

statuspage-bot: Draft status update saved: [INFERENCE-EU] Investigating increased latency after scheduled maintenance. Affected customers may experience slower responses. Working on a rollback if needed.

support_jen: Email template (short):
"Hi <customer>,
We performed a scheduled update to our inference runtime at 03:00 UTC. We're currently observing increased latency for some long-running chat sessions in EU. Our team is investigating and will either fix the issue or roll back to the previous version. We expect an update within 20 minutes. Sorry for the disruption — support@redwood.ai is monitoring your instances.
— Redwood Inference Ops"

product_jess: add an opt-out line for customers using dedicated pools: "If you would like us to pause tonight's update for your dedicated pool, reply and we'll hold to next window."

lena_ops: operational checklist for the oncall:
- monitor canary metrics: p50/p95/p99, 5xx, kernel OOMs
- check KV cache hit rates/eviction churn
- tail runtime logs for `cache_eviction` and `kernel_load` tags
- be ready to trigger rollback via deploy-bot: `deploy-bot rollback release/2.13.8 --region=eu`
- if rollback, publish statuspage: "Recovered — rollback complete" with ETA for full verification

mike_eng: also capture the exact canary customers list and pin their traffic to stable if they ask. I'll prepare the quick rollback command and smoke test script:
```
# rollback example
deploy-bot rollback --to=release/2.13.8 --region=eu --immediate
# smoke tests
curl -sS https://eu-api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .status
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://eu-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","prompt":"hello"}' | jq .choices[0].text
```

support_jen: ok please post the final statuspage snippets here so I can schedule the page and the customer emails. Will prepare a small Slack broadcast to Sales and AE's with the pinned-customer list once we start canary.

mike_eng: final statuspage snippets:
- Pre-deploy: "Planned maintenance: rolling runtime update in EU. Minimal impact expected. 03:00-04:00 UTC."
- During incident: "Investigating increased latency in EU inference. Some customers may see slower responses. Teams are actively triaging."
- Recovery: "Service restored in EU after rollback to previous runtime. Full verification underway."

product_jess: :thumbsup: ok to send draft to legal? I want a one-line compliance ack in the email for regulated customers.

lena_ops: sending now to legal and trust for a fast review. I'll ping again in 10m. :eyes:

support_jen: thanks team — keeping this thread for the live notes during deploy. I will update timestamps when the canary starts.

deploy-bot: Canary started: release/2.14.0 -> prod-eu (5% traffic). Started at 2026-03-21 03:05 UTC.

support_jen: (later) Canary metrics show p95 spike ~ 55% above baseline at 03:17 UTC, errors steady at 0.1%. Holding for 10m per policy.

mike_eng: saw the same. decision: continue hold and gather more data for 5m, prepare rollback command.

support_jen: (later) Canary continued. p95 now 62% higher and p50 +1.2s for pinned customer acme-inc for 12m -> triggering rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: rolling back to release/2.13.8 in prod-eu. Started at 2026-03-21 03:40 UTC.

statuspage-bot: Posted incident: [INFERENCE-EU] Increased latency; rollback in progress.

support_jen: rollback complete at 03:45 UTC. Publishing recovery note and sending customer emails. Closing thread after post-ops verification.

mike_eng: follow-up: open a regression ticket for KV eviction tuning + add unit to canary tests for long chats.

product_jess: will own the regression ticket and the customer follow-ups.

lena_ops: nice work. Saved notes to the maintenance playbook.

support_jen: thread closed.
